summary.text: Ron Mariano is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 3rd Norfolk District since 1992 and has served as Speaker of the House since December 2020; he is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Mariano was a teacher, and Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University and a graduate degree from the University of Massachusetts Boston.
He served on the Quincy School Committee from 1989 to 1995.
Mariano was first elected to the House in 1991 and took office in 1992. On December 30, 2020, he was sworn in as speaker.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
